cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've approved another attempt at our parade route. Two streets refused us; the whole town hasn't.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The only route left goes behind the supermarket.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then that's the route we're considering. Take the other pencil and show me where people could cheer by the loading bay.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My dad would come. He works there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your first spectator is approved. Put him on the map, then help me find a place for a second. You can see a parade there now, can't you?
